name: Hayley Hume-Merry
story: Boffa Miskell credits GIS Specialist Hayley Hume-Merry with geospatial design for Wellington City Council’s pre-1930 character-area review. The work combined desktop capture, iPad field verification and ArcGIS dashboards, showing GIS embedded in a planning and field-verification workflow.
